name: Оружейная
text: В свой ход уничтожьте оружейную, чтобы уничтожить 1 квартал на свой выбор.
scene: Preserve the armory interior and ALL original figures: foreground armored mustached man holding pole weapon at right, red-haired figure at left and smaller assistant behind him, distant figure above left. Preserve the shield displays, upright weapon rack, twin stair/balustrade, red and cream walls and small warm rear arch doorway. This is an armory not a new blacksmith scene: add no forge, sparks, extra people or weapons. Retain original painted shadows; soften the existing orange highlights, never brighter orange.
method: built-in image_gen edit; one original JPG reference; one initial generation

visualQA.title: correct visually
visualQA.composition: Armory figures, shield displays, weapon rack, stairs, red walls and arch retained.
limitations: Faces, weapons and armor silhouettes are generatively interpreted from low-resolution source.
